senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) same, mostly collect. all kind of fish, pieces of fish.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 51b:7">Ned. 51ᵇ</cite> if one says, ‘I will taste no <cite ref="D00097"><he>דג</he></cite>, he is forbidden to eat large fish &c.; if he says <cite ref="D00098"><he>דגה</he></cite> he is forbidden small fish &c.
Ib. ד׳ משמע גדולים וכ׳ dagah implies both large and small (in Biblical language), but in vows the popular usage is followed.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:1:4">Y. Bets. II, 61ᵇ</cite> top; a. fr.
